source.topic: Create efficient sanitized profile packet flow for criminology app

kb.query: sanitized profile packet PII removal criminology

proposed.scrumTitle: SCRUM (Planning): Sanitized Profile Packet Flow for Criminology
agenda: Intake: PII exposure risk in current criminology profile exports
Define sanitization requirements and compliance constraints
Design efficient PII detection and redaction pipeline
Implementation plan with agent handoffs (FrontDesk → IronClaw → ZeroClaw → HermitClaw)

tasks.title: Audit current profile structure for PII fields
tasks.description: Review ~/apps/criminology and ~/apps/criminology/falconeagle_packet to identify all PII-containing fields

tasks.title: Design sanitization pipeline
tasks.description: Create efficient flow that: 1) auto-detects PII, 2) anonymizes data, 3) maintains research utility, 4) logs redactions

tasks.title: Implement agent2agent handoff protocol
tasks.description: FrontDesk (intake) → IronClaw (PII redaction) → ZeroClaw (validation) → HermitClaw (audit logging)

tasks.title: Create sanitized packet export format
tasks.description: New export format that preserves research value while removing names, addresses, case numbers

tasks.title: Add compliance verification tests
tasks.description: Automated tests to verify no PII leaks in sanitized exports
